paper.title_en: Black hole free energy landscapes from constrained instantons
paper.abstract_en: We apply gravitational path integral factorization to provide a semiclassical interpretation of generalized black hole free energy landscapes at fixed external temperature and angular velocities. Boundary integral transforms express the formal partition function as an integral over constrained sectors labeled by complete local partial-Neumann data on an auxiliary hypersurface. Independent variation establishes paired regular subregion solutions as constrained instantons, with Lagrange multipliers supporting lapse and tangential shift jumps that accommodate thermal and rotational mismatches. For selected nonextremal stationary families with an asymptotic boundary, the constrained saddle action takes the form $I_{\rm constr}=β\mathcal F_{\rm gen}=β(E_{\mathcal B}-Ω_{\mathcal B}^{I}J_{\mathcal B,I})-S$, with $β=T^{-1}$. Here $E_{\mathcal B}$ and $J_{\mathcal B,I}$ are renormalized Hamiltonian charges and $S$ is the black hole entropy, whose contribution to the action comes from the regular horizon cap. Interior stationary points of the landscape correspond to smooth equilibrium saddles when the retained variations independently span the entropy and angular momentum directions. We extend the construction to local, parity-even $f(\mathrm{Riemann})$ theories without curvature derivatives by retaining the complete auxiliary interface data. The same thermodynamic form follows with Wald entropy, without a small-deficit expansion. Schwarzschild and Kerr black holes illustrate the Einstein construction, while five-dimensional static AdS black holes in Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet gravity and the rotating BTZ branch of new massive gravity provide explicit checks of the higher-curvature extension.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文以引力路径积分分解为工具，对固定外部温度与角速度下的广义黑洞自由能景观给出半经典解释，并以约束瞬子与部分Neumann数据构造约束鞍点作用，得到 I_constr=β(E_B−Ω^I_B J_{B,I})−S 的热力学形式。工作进一步推广至无曲率导数的宇称偶 f(Riemann) 理论并得到 Wald 熵形式，且用 Schwarzschild、Kerr、五维 AdS 爱因斯坦—高斯—博内黑洞与旋转 BTZ 分支作检验，理论上较深且以具体实例作交叉检验，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 约束瞬子给出的黑洞自由能景观
decision.abstract_zh: 我们应用引力路径积分分解，为固定外部温度和角速度下的广义黑洞自由能景观提供半经典解释。边界积分变换将形式配分函数表示为对约束扇区的积分，这些扇区由辅助超曲面上的完整局部偏 Neumann 数据标记。独立变分确立成对的正则子区域解为约束瞬子，其拉格朗日乘子支持 lapse 与切向 shift 的跳跃，以容纳热失配与转动失配。对于选定的具有渐近边界且非极端稳态族，约束鞍点作用取形式 $I_{\rm constr}=β\mathcal F_{\rm gen}=β(E_{\mathcal B}-Ω_{\mathcal B}^{I}J_{\mathcal B,I})-S$，其中 $β=T^{-1}$。这里 $E_{\mathcal B}$ 与 $J_{\mathcal B,I}$ 是重整化哈密顿荷，$S$ 是黑洞熵，其对作用的贡献来自正则视界帽。当所保留的变分独立张成熵与角动量方向时，景观的内部驻点对应于光滑平衡鞍点。我们将该构造推广到无曲率导数的局部、宇称偶 $f(\mathrm{Riemann})$ 理论，方法是保留完整的辅助界面数据。同样的热力学形式随之成立，并以 Wald 熵表述，不需要小亏缺展开。Schwarzschild 与 Kerr 黑洞说明了爱因斯坦构造，而爱因斯坦—高斯—博内引力中的五维静态 AdS 黑洞以及新大规模引力中的旋转 BTZ 分支为高阶曲率推广提供了显式检验。
